topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: You never know what you'll find in the muddy waters of life, but sometimes, a clear stretch opens up. I made my way back to the old neighborhood, the buildings still wearing the same weathered coats I remembered. Turned out, the kid had the same teacher I did, Mrs. Delaney. She was one of those steady lights in a storm, always calm, always believing you could do better. Watching the kid light up, talking about class, it felt like a rare moment when the past nods at the future, whispering something right. Maybe it’s just a small thing, a familiar face, but in a city where shadows pooled deep, it’s the little things that speak the loudest.
